cases.name: Brynn Ellen Rainey
cases.about: She was a Keno girl at the Sahara Tahoe Casino and worked the graveyard shift, which started at 2:00 AM. She enjoyed hiking, bicycle riding and sewing.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative: She was last seen at the Bitter Creek Saloon as she waiting for her work shift to start at the Sahara. Her nude body was found partially buried in a shallow grave by passing horseback riders near Stateline Stables in South Lake Tahoe. A purse with identification and clothing were found near the body. The pathologist thought the cause of death was strangulation or suffocation.
